title: STALocation
description: OGC SensorThings API v1.1 Location entity. Describes a geographic position of a Thing using GeoJSON Point encoding, as required by the STA specification. Used inline in STAThing.Locations array when creating a new station in FROST-Server.

name.description: Human-readable name for this location (e.g. station name).

location.description: GeoJSON Point geometry. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation] in WGS-84.

coordinates.description: [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation] in WGS-84.

properties.description: Optional freeform metadata stored alongside the Location.
